recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add a ClinicalImpression.code binding unless Patient Care makes a new explicit decision to restore that element; current coding needs should continue through ClinicalImpression.finding.item.
issue_request: FHIR-22734 asked to add a binding to ClinicalImpression.code, but the Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution was to remove ClinicalImpression.code because Patient Care found no known use case and expected outcomes to be represented with ClinicalImpression.finding.
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit 0ff2673b37d4c0be72524476b0c0d0dd9a0d5973 applied GF#22734 by marking the spreadsheet-era ClinicalImpression.code row as removed. The later StructureDefinition refactor carried forward the removal and did not reintroduce the element.
additional_context: The current source/clinicalimpression/structuredefinition-ClinicalImpression.xml resource definition lists the active ClinicalImpression differential elements and includes ClinicalImpression.finding.item as the coded/reference outcome path, but no ClinicalImpression.code. The current ClinicalImpression search-parameter bundle has finding-code and finding-ref, but no resource-level code search parameter. Community searches found no later conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already matches the Jira resolution.
